summary: SIM Acquisition Corp. I, a Nasdaq-listed Cayman SPAC, filed an 8-K disclosing an October 2, 2026 binding letter of intent to acquire American Industrial Technologies, Inc. (AIT), replacing its April 26 non-binding LOI. AIT will merge into a new SIM subsidiary, with SIM issuing roughly 50,000,000 common shares to AIT equityholders upon domestication to Nevada. AIT CEO John Chiorando becomes Combined Company CEO and Chairman; a 10% employee equity plan and 12-month insider lock-up are set. Definitive agreement terms, price, and premium are not yet disclosed; watch de-SPAC redemption and closing risk.
